Asks gun[3F0h]->vtable[1F4h](gun+3F4h) for a round; on failure writes the sentinel 00CFDBF8 into the barrel timer through 0072CF00, otherwise consumes through vtable[1F8h] and, when full, re-arms with a random reload drawn by 00BD2F10 from gun[3F8h]+28h..+2Ch. Argument shape read at 0072D555 and 0072D57E against the RET 8. docs/UNIT_WEAPON_DEVICES.md.

name: BSP_Gun_SelectBulletRecord
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Partial: 0072D5D1-0072D61C read; the tail to 0072D6DB is unread. Returns early when the index already equals gun+3FCh, then stores the index at 0072D610 and re-points two pointers: gun+3B4h = [gun+3A8h] + idx*14h (0072D5FA) and gun+3F8h = [[gun+3F4h]+74h] + idx*48h (0072D61C, the LEA EAX,[EAX+EAX*8] / [EAX+EDX*8] stride-72 form). Because gun+3F8h is the fire-parameter record, switching ammunition type switches the gun's ReloadTime, BarrelDelayTime, Throw and bullet class together. The same 48h stride appears in docs/GUNNERY_CANDIDATE_ORDER.md as [gun+3F4h]+74h + (kind == 6 ? 48h : 0). docs/GUN_SHOT_CADENCE.md.

name: BSP_Gun_HandleNetworkMessage
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(gun)(message). Gun vtable slot 164h for the base class: a switch on the byte at message+10h. 4Bh and 4Ch are ignored, 68h runs vtable[1C8h], 69h vtable[1CCh], 0ACh calls 0072D5B0 and 0ADh runs vtable[1DCh] FireIfReady. docs/GUN_AIMING.md.

name: BSP_Gun_Construct
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(this)(arg). Installs the gun vtable 00CFE0A8 and writes the class id 20h at +C4h, which is the id the class test vtable[5Ch](20h) selects on in the device walk 008CF350 and the torpedo re-arm 0081F8B0. Base of the whole gun family; its own base 00728960 is unread. A second constructor 0072D950 installs the same vtable. docs/GUN_CLASS_FAMILY.md.

name: BSP_Gun_SetupFromDescriptor
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall(ECX = gun), body 0072E6D0-0072F053, RET. The producer of the gun's barrel layout: writes barrelNum at 0072E71A, nextFireBarrel at 0072E72A, delayGroupSize and barrelDelayTime at 0072E8DB, sizing the device from its weapon descriptor. Only those writes were read; the rest of the body is unread. docs/UNIT_WEAPON_DEVICES.md. | Packet cc7_gun_mount_positions: the mount node chain. 0072E98A stores [[gun+360h]+160h]+0Ch to gun+3BCh; 0072E9E2-0072E9F0 calls 0071AD50(model, "base" at 00CFACD8) into gun+3C4h; 0072EA10-0072EA1C calls 0071AD50(model, "barrel" at 00CF70C4) into gun+3C8h; 0072EE65-0072EE8F sets gun+3CCh, the node the gun fires from, to the first non-null of +3C8h, +3C4h, +3BCh, with 0072EE6F storing null first so 'no node' is the default. 0072E713 seeds gun+448h from BSP_GunClass_MuzzleCount 0072AB80 and 0072E72A zeroes gun+44Ch. Coverage partial: 0072E6F5..0072E73A and 0072E93D..0072EE97 only; 0071AD50's body is a contract of the model/scene packet. docs/GUN_MOUNT_POSITIONS.md section 3.

name: BSP_Gun_TargetShotDecision
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_gun_platform_arc, read-only analysis. __thiscall(gun+424h)(int targetKey) -> bool, body 0072F6E0-0072F82B, reached through the 00730A20 thunk. Returns 1 when gun+42Ch is zero. Otherwise it searches the 0Ch-byte records of the vector at gun+430h/+434h/+438h for record[0] == targetKey and returns the cached byte at record[1]; on a miss it calls 00729670, draws a random value in [00CE74F8, 00CE3814) scaled by GlobalConfig+8Ch, appends {key, decision, scaledValue} and returns the fresh decision.

name: BSP_Gun_SpawnShotAndEffects
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_projectile_impact, read-only analysis. __thiscall(gun, float* spawnPos, float* effectPos, void* a3, int flag), RET 10h at 0073015A, body 0072F830-0073015C. Reached from gun Fire 00730160 step 10 per docs/UNIT_WEAPON_DEVICES.md. Builds the muzzle point effects from gun[+3F8h]+0Ch/+10h on the identity matrix at 00E1AE30, starts or stops the looped effect, adds the first-person camera shake, computes the spawn flag from gun[+440h]/[+444h] (a zero word suppresses the shot), rejects ten sub-types in world mode, then calls 0072BF10 once at 00730076 or gun[+3F4h]+0CCh times around a cone at 00730042, and ends with the fire sound 0077C7B0. Frame ESP0 = entry-0E8h, so EBX at 0072F882 is the second argument and EDI at 0072FEF0 the first. docs/PROJECTILE_IMPACT.md | Packet cc7_gun_dispersion: this routine is NOT a dispersion producer. It holds exactly one RNG call, 0072FB6A, which draws U(0.075f, 0.225f) from 00CEED68/00CFE2B4 on stream 1 into gun[+3F0h]+6F8h for weapon Functions 2, 3, 4 and 6 - an effect timer. The 0072FEFB..00730035 loop is deterministic: theta_i = 2*pi*i/gunclass[+0CCh] (OneTimeBulletAmount, stored at 00732AE4) on a ring of radius gunclass[+0D0h] (MultiBulletConeAngle, stored at 00732B1C), both produced by BSP_GunClass_ReadLuaFields 007327B0. The Throw cone is drawn one frame up in BSP_Gun_Fire 00730160. docs/GUN_DISPERSION.md | Packet cc7_gun_mount_positions: argument meanings settled. __thiscall(gun)(const float* muzzleWorld, const float* muzzleLocal, const float* direction, int flag); RET 10h at 0073015A and four pushes at 0073082D-0073083D. arg1 is the WORLD muzzle point BSP_Gun_Fire produces at 00730762..007307FC as 004142E0(class->muzzleOffsets[gun+44Ch], mountNodeMatrix); arg2 is the same offset in the node's local space, used at 0072F8B7-0072F8E4 to place the muzzle-flash effect matrix; arg3 is the shot DIRECTION, row 2 of the mount node matrix perturbed by the dispersion cone, which 0072FE74 hands to gun vtable slot 1E0h; arg4 is a bool read at 0072FD79. 0072BF10 receives (arg1 = pos, slot-1E0h result = dir) at 00730042 and 00730076, matching docs/PROJECTILE_IMPACT.md's 0072C006 argument list. docs/GUN_MOUNT_POSITIONS.md.
